steps.text: Time comes in different units — seconds, minutes, hours. Let's convert between them.
Enter a value and convert it. Remember: 1 minute = 60 seconds, and 1 hour = 60 minutes.
To go to a smaller unit, multiply (hours → minutes → seconds: ×60 each step). To go to a bigger unit, divide (÷60 each step).
So 2 hours = 120 minutes = 7,200 seconds. Getting the units right is the first step in any speed or time problem.

coach.mission: Convert a time between seconds, minutes, and hours.
whenStuck: Use 1 minute = 60 seconds and 1 hour = 60 minutes.
Smaller unit → multiply by 60; bigger unit → divide by 60.
whenWrong: Going to a smaller unit multiplies by 60; going to a bigger unit divides by 60.
whenCorrect: Right — the conversion factor is 60 at each step.
Good — units line up correctly now.
coach.done: You've converted between time units. Try more values, or move on when you're ready.
